title: Alkali-metal- and halide-free dinuclear mixed-valent samarium and europium complexes

synthesis.procedure: Adapted from Zhou et al. A toluene solution of octaethylcalix[4]pyrrole (0.124 g, 0.23 mmol in 2.0 mL toluene) was added dropwise to a toluene solution of Sm(N(SiMe3)2)3(μ-Cl)Li(thf)3 (0.407 g, 0.458 mmol in 5.5 mL toluene) under nitrogen, stirred at room temperature for six days and then at 100 °C for one day. Solvent was removed under vacuum and the residue extracted with pentane. Needle-like crystals were obtained by slow evaporation of pentane.
synthesis.temperature: room temperature for 6 days, then 100 °C for 1 day
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Solvent removed under vacuum, extracted with pentane, and crystallized by slow evaporation of pentane.

properties.summary: 1-Sm is weakly emissive and shows the Sm(III) 4G5/2 → 6HJ (J = 5/2, 7/2, 9/2) emission lines; excitation at 320 nm in pentane is given in the SI.

synthesis.procedure: Prepared by the same procedure used for the samarium analogue: a toluene solution of octaethylcalix[4]pyrrole was added to Eu(N(SiMe3)2)3(μ-Cl)Li(thf)3 under nitrogen, stirred at room temperature for six days and then at 100 °C for one day, followed by solvent removal, pentane extraction, and crystallization. The SI reports the isolated yield but does not restate separate reagent masses for the europium run.
synthesis.temperature: room temperature for 6 days, then 100 °C for 1 day
synthesis.vessel_or_method: toluene solution under nitrogen, same procedure as 1-Sm
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Same workup as 1-Sm: vacuum removal of solvent, pentane extraction, and crystallization.

synthesis.procedure: To a THF solution of 1-Sm (0.036 g, 0.031 mmol) under nitrogen was added sodium amalgam (0.007 g, 0.304 mmol Na in Hg) at room temperature and the mixture was stirred overnight. After separation of the amalgam, solvent was removed under vacuum. The brown solid was dissolved in pentane and treated with a drop of 12-crown-4 diluted in pentane. The precipitated solid was filtered off and the solvent removed under vacuum. Single crystals could not be grown.
synthesis.vessel_or_method: THF solution under nitrogen, sodium-amalgam reduction
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Amalgam separated, solvent removed, pentane solution treated with 12-crown-4, precipitate filtered, and solvent removed. No single crystals obtained.

properties.summary: The mixed-valent complex shows new absorption bands centered at 400 and 560 nm, consistent with Sm(II), and remains weakly emissive with Sm(III) 4G5/2 → 6HJ lines.

synthesis.procedure: To a THF solution of 1-Eu (0.035 g, 0.029 mmol) under nitrogen was added sodium amalgam (0.007 g, 0.304 mmol Na in Hg) at room temperature and the mixture was stirred overnight. After separation of the amalgam, solvent was removed under vacuum. The dark brown solid was dissolved in pentane and treated with a drop of 12-crown-4 diluted in pentane. The precipitate was filtered off and the filtrate concentrated by slow evaporation to give needle-like crystals.
synthesis.vessel_or_method: THF solution under nitrogen, sodium-amalgam reduction
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Amalgam separated, solvent removed, pentane/12-crown-4 treatment, filtration, and slow evaporation of the filtrate to needle-like crystals.

synthesis.procedure: Silanol route: a THF solution of silanol (0.003 g, 0.034 mmol) was added dropwise at room temperature to a THF solution of 2-Sm (0.036 g, 0.034 mmol) under nitrogen. The mixture was stirred for eight days, solvent removed, and the greenish-brown crude dissolved in pentane and concentrated by slow evaporation to needle-like crystals (18 mg, 58%). Water route: one equivalent of a dilute, nitrogen-sparged water solution in THF was added dropwise at 0 °C to a THF solution of 2-Sm (0.036 g, 0.034 mmol) under nitrogen. The mixture was stirred for 1 h at 0 °C, solvent removed, and the crude crystallized from pentane (10 mg, 33%). The crystal contains two toluene molecules of solvation.

reagents.name: water
reagents.amount: one equivalent of a dilute THF solution

synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Solvent removed under vacuum and the greenish-brown residue crystallized by slow evaporation of pentane.
